hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the roadway behind the concrete barrier

hazards.name: Restricted Visibility
hazards.description: The overpass structure creates shadows and a tunnel effect that can reduce the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Upper half of the image under the bridge deck

hazards.name: Poor Sightlines
hazards.description: Large bridge support pillars and the low overhead structure significantly limit visibility for pedestrians and potential drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Middle ground, bridge supports

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Pillars
hazards.description: Large bridge support pillars create significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians, hiding potential movements.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway along the walkway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crossings are visible across this wide roadway, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected if needed.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire visible roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from infrastructure
hazards.description: Large bridge support columns block sightlines between drivers and any potential pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of image under the bridge structure

hazards.name: High-speed traffic proximity
hazards.description: Pedestrians on the narrow sidewalk are immediately adjacent to multiple lanes of high-speed traffic with no physical separation.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the sidewalk edge

hazards.name: Poor Visibility and Sightlines
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates a dark environment, and the massive columns block sightlines between pedestrians on the walkway and drivers on the road.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the under-bridge area

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install bright, high-quality LED lighting under the overpass specifically aimed at the walkway and bike lane to improve safety and security.

interventions.title: Protected Bike/Pedestrian Lane
interventions.description: Add physical barriers such as bollards or concrete curbs to separate the green lane from motorized traffic.

interventions.title: Reflective Pillar Wraps
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility reflective materials to the bridge pillars to improve driver awareness and reduce the impact of blind spots.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Restoration and Widening
interventions.description: Remove the concrete barriers and widen the sidewalk to meet ADA standards, providing a clear and safe path of travel.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve safety.

interventions.title: Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting mounted to the underside of the elevated structure to improve visibility and perceived safety.

interventions.title: Heel-safe and Bike-safe Grates
interventions.description: Replace existing wide-gap drainage grates with designs that prevent heels or thin tires from getting caught.

interventions.title: Public Art and Murals
interventions.description: Apply murals to the blank walls and pillars to improve the aesthetic quality and reduce the hostile feel of the industrial environment.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-quality, pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and the sense of security in the shadowed area.

interventions.title: Delineated Pedestrian Paths
interventions.description: Use paint, bollards, or different paving materials to clearly define pedestrian routes through the parking and access areas.

interventions.title: Placemaking and Activation
interventions.description: Introduce public art or small-scale commercial activity to increase foot traffic and natural surveillance under the structure.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install physical vertical separation, such as bollards or a concrete curb, between the bike lane and the travel lanes to protect non-motorized users.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds in this transitional area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk with a buffer from the high-speed roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median or refuge island to break up the long crossing distance across the multi-lane road.

interventions.title: Enhanced Street Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting levels under the overpass to increase visibility and personal security.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the driveway/parking access point to shorten crossing distances and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Public Art or Activation
interventions.description: Use murals or lighting installations on the bridge pillars to improve the aesthetic quality and make the space feel more welcoming.

interventions.title: Physical Separation
interventions.description: Install a crash-rated barrier or bollards between the sidewalk and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Enhanced Lighting
interventions.description: Improve under-bridge lighting to increase pedestrian visibility and perceived safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the walkway to provide more space away from the curb.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Remove the concrete barriers and construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk with a minimum width of 6 feet.

interventions.title: Under-bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting under the elevated structure to improve visibility and personal security.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds and reallocate space for a protected pedestrian facility.

interventions.title: Install Physical Buffer
interventions.description: Add bollards, planters, or a raised curb extension to provide physical separation between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Safety Railing
interventions.description: Install a protective railing or a secure grate over the drainage basin to prevent pedestrians from falling into the structure.

interventions.title: Under-Bridge Activation
interventions.description: Use bright, reflective paint or public art on the piers to improve the aesthetic quality and increase the perceived safety of the corridor.

interventions.title: Physical Separation Barrier
interventions.description: Install a concrete barrier or heavy-duty bollards to physically separate the pedestrian walkway from the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Buffering
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to slow traffic and use the reclaimed space to create a wide, buffered zone for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Underpass Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity pedestrian-scale lighting under the overpass to improve visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Wayfinding and Signage
interventions.description: Provide clear directional signage to help pedestrians navigate the isolated area and connect to nearby destinations.

interventions.title: Public Art or Murals
interventions.description: Apply murals or artistic treatments to the bridge pillars to improve the aesthetic quality and perceived safety of the space.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement marked crossings with appropriate signage to provide safe points for pedestrians to traverse the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and shorten the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Install Protected Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a raised sidewalk with a physical buffer to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.
